content:
I have recently completed a personal project to formalize Brauer's induction
theorem for induced characters in Lean 4:

https://github.com/norbsvr/BrauerInduction

The project took about seven months. It was a stepwise development with
substantial AI assistance, predominantly ChatGPT and occasionally Gemini AI,
using £20/month AI subscriptions.

The repository also includes a leanprover/comparator harness comparing a
challenge statement against the main project theorem.

I am making the project public in the hope that parts of it may be useful or interesting
to other Lean users. Comments, suggestions, or pointers to related work are very
welcome. So, if you are interested, take a look!
Congrats for the nice result! Some data I pulled from https://codetabs.com/count-loc/count-loc-online.html:
